task:
DO NOT CALL ANY TOOLS. Return the engineering verdict immediately from this complete evidence packet. Live failure: immediately after /reload on master Feltaxi, while idle, WoW repeatedly prints red server flood-control 'You must wait 6/10 Seconds before speaking again.' Fleet has 4 subordinate summoners.

FleetCounter base: each subordinate sends FCV to master every HB=12s. Base onHeartbeat updates peer and calls C.capability(sender), where capability sends FCE whisper. Master base update also used to C.broadcast() FCE to all peers every 12s.

1.81 FleetChatBurstGuard currently wraps C.capability to ENQUEUE one pending FCE per peer, replaces C.broadcast() with no-op, and drains queue at SEND_GAP=2.20 seconds. Thus with 4 peers synchronized at reload, master sends FCE at approximately t=.75,2.95,5.15,7.35; after the next FCV wave at ~12s they queue again, producing effectively one outgoing control whisper every ~2.2-3s for much of runtime. It also suppresses legacy FallbackRouter H/D chatter by setting nextHelloAt and nextDirectoryPushAt far ahead every 0.1s.

FleetPresenceBootstrap explicitly intends FCV to be the one presence heartbeat. CrossRouteTransaction currently uses FCE field 5 to refresh non-master F.directory. FCE also carries active flag, price, rosterCsv and freshServices. Non-master considers master capability fresh for TTL=38s.

Fleet advert FAH discovery is already disabled by canonical discovery. Idle advert interval is 5-8min and not the observed per-seconds spam. Transaction R/X/A occurs only on customer requests and is idle here. SlaveMasterPair can InviteByName missing fixed slaves every 5s but does not call SendChatMessage.

Question: Is 1.81 still architecturally chatty enough to trigger flood control? Design minimal robust control-plane cadence for 4-5 bots that preserves TTL semantics and route correctness. Consider per-peer FCE min refresh, state-change pushes, jitter/stagger, and whether non-master route should depend on FCE directory at all. Avoid adding another independent heartbeat. Give: 1) exact diagnosis, 2) recommended cadence/numbers, 3) minimal patch shape, 4) invariants, 5) idle/reload stress test. Under 650 words.
